proposed_record.reviewerRationale: NORTAC Defence is already published with stable organization and capability identities. This refresh is warranted because the WAVE/TACTICAL citation currently shown on the public capability resolves to a removed 2024 PDF, while Nortac now maintains a live Team Deployment Kit page and Iridium independently maintains a detailed WAVE product and partner record. The candidate updates the combined WAVE/NTAC capability in place, adds the official CAD 250,000 FedDev amount and Android satellite-application purpose to organization activity context while leaving the existing FedDev relationship unchanged, and adds bounded Shared Services Canada, CanExport SME, historical PWGSC, and Iridium partner records. It is amber despite strong evidence because Nortac's claims of greater than 90 percent Canadian Content Value, security clearances, Canadian AWS hosting, and TRL 9 remain company-authored or interview-attributed; no customer-specific operational deployment, current DND end user, independently verified performance, ownership register, or current contract beyond the disclosed records was recovered.

Nortac's greater than 90 percent Canadian Content Value, Facility Security Clearance, Document Safeguarding Certification, Canadian AWS hosting, non-ITAR status, and TRL 9 claims are not applied as canonical fields without independent confirmation.

Shared Services contract 700611230 ended in 2023, PWGSC contract EN869-118133/002/EO ended in 2014, and CanExport agreement 1035233 ended in February 2026; retain their historical lifecycle boundaries.
No public record recovered a named current military end user, operational deployment, quantified performance result, active DND procurement, or specific NATO DIANA selection.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: FedDev Ontario identifies NORTAC Defence as the recipient of CAD 250,000 to commercialize Android satellite applications for mobile command and control in limited-network environments.
Shared Services Canada discloses competitive multidepartmental contract 700611230 with NORTAC Defence Limited, a 2020-2023 term, and a CAD 4,321,486.27 total value.
Nortac's patent-marking page lists Canadian patent 3081732 and related U.S. patents for TITAN, WAVE, and low-bandwidth short-burst-data situational awareness.

Iridium currently lists WAVE with AES-256 encryption, two-way and group messaging, emergency alerting, configurable reporting from 15-second intervals, IP67 protection, -20 to +60 C operation, and a glove-operable touchscreen.
CDR describes NTAC as a remote TITAN component for tablets and laptops and describes WAVE messaging, alerting, position reporting, and direct situational-awareness display.
Nortac's current Solutions page offers light, medium, and heavy kits including WAVE, NTAC, WAVE 88, platform access, airtime, training, and support.
The official recipient table gives NORTAC Defence a CAD 250,000 investment for Android satellite-application commercialization serving military personnel and non-military first responders.
The federal contract record identifies the vendor, buyer, scope, competitive method, term, contract number, and total value for contract 700611230.
The grants record identifies NORTAC Defence Limited as a CAD 23,650 CanExport SME recipient for export-market development from May 2025 to February 2026.
CanadaBuys identifies NORTAC Defence Limited on competitive contract EN869-118133/002/EO with a CAD 800,000 total value and 2011-2014 lifecycle.
Iridium's current partner directory lists NORTAC Defence, TITAN and WAVE, Ottawa contact details, satellite airtime and devices, training, installation, and 24/7 support.
CIPO shows the NORTAC TACTICAL word-mark application was abandoned in April 2026; this is a trademark-status fact and is not treated as evidence that NTAC was withdrawn.
The TRL 9 and broad federal procurement-channel statements appear as founder interview claims; the candidate leaves maturity and current deployment unset pending independent evidence.
